name: Sarah
source:
Some might consider her the ice queen but she's actually quite friendly once you get to know her! However, she swears that Dark Apostle(MC’s superhero name) killed her grandfather and seeks vengeance...Will you be able to convince her otherwise?

[From Genius Bishoujo]
